task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Pick the sauce can with flat bottom up and move it next to the medium kitchenpot made of metal
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架将平底朝上的酱罐拿起并移动到金属中型厨房锅旁边
